title: Bounded monomial independent
statement: Let k be a field, d,m natural numbers, h in R=k[X_0,...,X_{d-1}], and p_i a monic polynomial over k[X_0,...,X_{d+i}] of natural degree e_i. Let Q be the simultaneous quotient by hT-1 and the triangular p_i, and D=Localization.Away h. Suppose psi:D→ₐ[k]Q agrees on R with the canonical renamed quotient map. If c is a D-valued function on the bounded exponent tuples and the sum over a of psi(c(a)) times product_i [Y_i]^(a_i) is zero in Q, then c is identically zero. Zero h, zero degrees, and m=0 are allowed.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07BV, first assertion, triangular minimal polynomials and denominator clearing; Tag 08JZ, localization presentation. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07BV and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JZ because the local literature checkout is absent.

proof.text: Induct on m, generalizing the triangular polynomial family, degree bounds, localization map and coefficient function. For m=0, evaluate the first d variables at their classes in D=Localization.Away h and T at invSelf h. The localization relation vanishes by mul_invSelf. Descend evaluation to the quotient; its composite with psi is the identity by localization ringHom_ext and agreement on the base ring. The singleton coefficient sum is therefore zero only when its coefficient is zero. This constructs the left inverse directly; no localization-presentation isomorphism is needed.

At a successor, restrict p and e along Fin.castSucc. The class of h is invertible in the preceding quotient, with inverse the class of T, since hT-1 belongs to the defining ideal. Construct psi₀ using IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom and prove its base-ring agreement with lift_eq. This is an explicit construction, not a choice of an unspecified witness.

For every last exponent j, apply coefficient descent to obtain a zero expansion in the preceding quotient for a ↦ c(Fin.snoc a j). Apply the induction hypothesis to the restricted monic family to obtain that this function is zero. For an arbitrary full exponent tuple a, evaluate that zero function at Fin.init a and j=a(last n); Fin.snoc_init_self recovers c(a)=0. Empty exponent types are handled without positivity hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07BV (lemma-colimit-syntomic), first assertion: successive triangular monic equations; Tag 08JZ (lemma-localize-at-element), localization presentation. The proof uses an explicit map into the last AdjoinRoot rather than a quotient isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem triangularFieldModel_bounded_independent
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d m : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (e : Fin m → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic)
    (he : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree = e i)
    (psi : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k]
      (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p)))
    (hpsi : ∀ r : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k,
      psi (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away h) r) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        (MvPolynomial.rename (fun j : Fin d ↦
          (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + m))) r))
    (c : (((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)) → Localization.Away h))
    (hc : (∑ a : ((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)),
        psi (c a) * (∏ i : Fin m,
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X
            (⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + m)))) ^ (a i).val)) = 0) : c = 0
